data.spec: Define and implement a reserved per-project transcript ref namespace that stores each agent run's raw UTF-8 transcript as an immutable, run-addressed blob with enough metadata to associate it with the project, role, task, actor, timestamps, exit outcome, and truncation/error state. Extend RefStore read/write/sync behavior without admitting transcript objects into the protocol event union or materialized view, use compare-and-swap/force-with-lease semantics consistent with existing Particle refs, and cover cumulative writes, idempotency, concurrent or stale writers, remote recovery, binary/size limits, and ref enumeration in focused Git-store tests. Update the protocol documentation to distinguish auditable raw transcripts from canonical project events.
data.title: Add durable transcript refs to the Git store
